name: A+ Composites GmbH
about:
A+ Composites is a German technology company specializing in the development and manufacture of customized thermoplastic unidirectional (UD) tapes for advanced composite applications. Since its founding in 2015, the company has established itself as an innovation leader by combining patented manufacturing technologies with deep materials expertise to deliver high-performance composite solutions for demanding industrial markets. Our core business is the development of tailor-made UD tapes engineered for maximum process efficiency, dimensional precision, and mechanical performance. With more than 250 customized tape variants, A+ Composites offers an extensive portfolio based on carbon, glass, aramid, polymer, and specialty fibers combined with high-performance thermoplastic matrices including PA6, PA12, PPS, PEEK, PEKK, LMPAEK, PP, PE, and many others. Every material system is optimized to meet the specific requirements of the customer's application and manufacturing process. A key differentiator is our patented production technology, which enables exceptionally tight width tolerances, homogeneous fiber impregnation, and outstanding process consistency. These characteristics significantly improve automated manufacturing processes such as Automated Fiber Placement (AFP), Automated Tape Laying (ATL), filament winding, thermoforming, and hybrid overmolding while reducing scrap rates and increasing production efficiency. Recent developments, including low-crystallinity thermoplastic UD tapes, enable substantially shorter processing cycles without compromising mechanical performance, making thermoplastic composites increasingly attractive for high-volume production. Beyond material development, A+ Composites works closely with customers throughout the entire product development cycle—from material selection and prototype development to industrialization and serial production. Our engineering team supports the optimization of lightweight structures with customized semi-finished products including UD tapes, organosheets, preforms, and textile reinforcements designed for automated manufacturing environments. Our solutions serve a broad range of industries, including aerospace, space, automotive, rail, medical technology, industrial automation, oil and gas, pressure vessels, and advanced mobility. Current development projects include thermoplastic composite solutions for cryogenic tanks, hydrogen technologies, radar-transparent and radar-absorbing structures, lightweight rail components, and next-generation high-temperature composite systems. Close collaborations with research institutes, industrial partners, and OEMs ensure that our technologies continuously address the evolving needs of advanced manufacturing. Sustainability is an integral part of our innovation strategy. By focusing on fully thermoplastic composite systems, recyclable material concepts, and highly efficient automated manufacturing processes, we enable customers to reduce waste, improve resource efficiency, and develop lightweight products with a lower environmental footprint. At CAMX, A+ Composites will showcase its latest generation of precision-engineered thermoplastic UD tapes and semi-finished products designed to accelerate automated composite manufacturing while delivering superior performance, reliability, and sustainability. We look forward to collaborating with industry partners, exploring new applications, and helping shape the future of advanced thermoplastic composites.

name: Cevotec GmbH
about:
Cevotec offers advanced production equipment and software for the automated production of complex fiber composites in aerospace. At the intersection of composites, mechanical engineering, robotics, and software, Cevotec develops Robotic Lamination solutions based on Fiber Patch Placement (FPP) technology. Robotic Lamination is an industrial pick-and-place lamination technology that extends the toolset for high-precision, high-rate composite lay-up. It enables conformable 3D fiber placement on geometrically complex surfaces with a wide range of difficult-to-handle materials, e.g. carbon fibers, glass fibers, adhesive films, and other technical materials. Cevotec's modular process equipment (SAMBA Series equipment) is enabled by dedicated CAD-CAM software (ARTIST STUDIO). The equipment can be configured to serve different lay-up tasks and replace work that, until now, only a skilled composite technician could do by hand. Unlike conventional tape-based lay-up technologies, Robotic Lamination can process complex surfaces, steep edges, small radii, multi-material laminate stacks, and locally optimized reinforcements. Typical applications include mid-sized, multi-material aircraft composite parts like radomes, nacelles and fairings for defense, space, and UAV programs. The modular SAMBA Series equipment covers use cases ranging from research and prototyping to industrial series production. Cevotec also offers retrofit solutions that add Robotic Lamination capabilities to existing robot cells. Automated quality inspection with cevoVision supports reliable process control and verifies patch presence, position, and placement quality. All system configurations are represented as digital twins in ARTIST STUDIO. The software supports laminate design, automated offline programming, robotic motion generation, and lay-up process simulation, creating an integrated digital workflow from component design to production. By switching from manual or conventional manufacturing processes to Robotic Lamination, manufacturers can achieve cost and time savings of 20% to 60% while improving repeatability, material utilization, production scalability, and process transparency.

name: Diab
about:
Diab’s high-performance core materials can be found in applications all over the world, in industries like marine, aerospace, wind energy and transport, making them more competitive and sustainable. We produce our own material, ensuring a secure supply chain and achieving efficient and sustainable management. And we are always exploring new ways to improve our offering and help you make your products stronger, lighter and smarter. Sandwich structures contribute to the development of a more sustainable society. Firstly, due to their low-density properties, the cores themselves require a small amount of raw material, which also means that relatively little must be transported from the source to the construction site. Secondly, the lightweight and aerodynamic sandwich design reduces fuel consumption and emission throughout the entire lifetime of the application, saving both cost and the environment. Thirdly, very few or no additional natural resources are needed to repair or renew the applications, since composite materials are weather and corrosion-resistant, which means a minimum of maintenance and a long lifespan. Less weight means better fuel efficiency, lower emissions, higher speed, higher payload, longer range and lower transport costs. With lighter and fewer components installations can be done faster and cheaper. Sandwich composites provide excellent mechanical properties to much lower weight than traditional monolithic materials, such as steel. They can also be engineered with extreme precision to their loading requirements. Applications that require a very high strength material at the lowest possible weight benefit greatly from a sandwich structure since they can be designed to be both strong and light. Also, when something is built with metal, and greater strength is required in one direction, the total structure ends up even heavier. Composites can be engineered to be strong in a specific direction and still be light weight. When you need a very specific shape for your application, a composite solution is your answer. Composites can be molded into almost any shape, which gives full design freedom. When building sandwich composite structures, the materials are shapeable until the last stage of production in which they get their final shape. This allows for non-linear and smooth designs, which can be done not only for esthetic but also aerodynamic reasons. The skins of a sandwich could be of any material such as fiber-reinforced plastics, metal, wood, decorative laminates and even ceramics. All for the purpose of the final application or design aspect. Durable and corrosion-resistant, sandwich composites are gaining ground in almost every industry sector. Today, you will find them in windmills, aircraft interiors, trains and trailers, cargo ships, luxury yachts and satellite dishes. Tomorrow, they will be everywhere. Potential applications for these high-strength, weight-saving materials are limitless. If you can imagine it, we can probably help you build it. Offering low weight, high strength and great flexibility, applications using sandwich composites can be bent, curved and joined together in an almost limitless range of geometric configurations. We are at the core of your sustainable solution!
